h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kerala & Tamil Nadu

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kerala & Tamil Nadu

items.pText: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment across Kerala and Tamil Nadu, from apartment projects in Kochi and Chennai to schools in Madurai and Coimbatore and resorts in the hills. We design and make every piece at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, where we have worked since 2002. The equipment reaches the south by road and is installed by our own team or a dealer in the region.

The two states share a long coastline and two monsoons, yet the conditions on a site in Alappuzha are very different from those in Tiruchirappalli or Ooty. Humidity and salt air decide the choice of materials on the coast, while the dry interior of Tamil Nadu raises questions of heat and shade. Hill sites need a firm base on sloping ground. We plan each layout with these differences in mind, and send a drawing with the safe play area marked before anything is made.

props.h3Text: Top Factors Which Make Us a Leading Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer in Kerala?

items.pText: We make a wide range of products for small parks, gardens, outdoor areas, and spaces. We design the equipment that fits in every area. Apart from that, our team visits the area and takes accurate measurements. They build a high standard of products as per the demands of the clients. We manufacture the playground equipment for age starting from 4 years to 10 years.

Our efficient team has been appreciated for punctuality and timely services. We try our best to complete every project within the given time. In addition to that, being the most trusted Outdoor Playground Equipment manufacturer in Kerala we follow every instruction of the clients and work according to their choice. There is no delay in our service and clients choose us for our accurate services.

The long-lasting products make us the leading Outdoor Playground Equipment manufacturer in Kerala. We build products using tested materials. Apart from that, we also take care of quality at every stage of the manufacturing cycle. Our products remain in good condition even after many years. They do not break or damage due to wind force, rainwater, snowfall, or other environmental hazards.

We pick good raw materials to design outdoor playground tools. After deciding the raw materials, our technicians also check them in our plant. Our products are safe for all children. They do not get injuries by using our playground equipment. Furthermore, our tools do not harm the environment or pollute the air in any way.

Whether it is Public Park, Fun Park,school or outdoor areas, we design play systems for every playground. We manufacture the products after knowing the needs and budget of the clients. Our products include merry go round, climbing frames, spring rockers, Slides, Tots world and so on. They fit in any area and on any type of ground.

richText.heading: Supplying the coast, the plains and the hills

c: On the Kerala coast and in Chennai, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic hold up best against humid, salty air. We suggest rinsing the equipment now and then and following the maintenance steps we give at handover. In the plains of Tamil Nadu, around Madurai, Tiruchirappalli and Salem, summers are long and hot, so shade over slides and decks matters as much as the equipment itself.
For hill stations in the Western Ghats, such as Munnar, Ooty and Kodaikanal, the ground is often uneven. We level the base and choose grouting where the soil is soft. City pages such as

richText.heading: Who buys playground equipment in the south

c: Builders in Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram, Chennai and Coimbatore want a finished play area for apartment and villa projects. CBSE, ICSE and state board schools ask for equipment that serves several age groups on one ground. Resorts and homestays along the backwaters, and in the hills, look for a feature piece that families remember, and we have installed a resort playground near Dindigul.
Parks run by city corporations need equipment that takes heavy evening crowds. Designs from our
range, many inspired by Indian games and nature, work well where a school or resort wants something different from a standard slide and swing set.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Kerala and Tamil Nadu?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai and send the equipment by road. Our installation team or a dealer in the region sets it up on your site. Share your town and site photos first, so we can plan dispatch and the installation day together.

items.q: Which materials suit humid coastal sites?
items.a: Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts, because plastic does not rust and the zinc coating protects the steel. Rinse the equipment from time to time if the site is close to the sea.

items.q: Can you install on sloping ground in the hills?
items.a: Yes. We look at the site photos and levels, prepare a level base and use grouting or the self-standing method depending on the soil. The layout drawing shows the safe play area around each piece.

It covers manufacturing defects. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry three years, and springs, bearings and spare parts carry one year, provided installation and upkeep follow our instructions.
